import networkx as nx
G = nx.Graph()
G.add_edges_from(edges)

print("Degrees:", dict(G.degree()))
print("Min degree:", min(dict(G.degree()).values()))

from networkx.algorithms.clique import find_cliques
max_clique = max(len(c) for c in find_cliques(G))
print("Max clique:", max_clique)

from networkx.algorithms.coloring import greedy_color
coloring = greedy_color(G, strategy='largest_first')
print("Chromatic number (greedy):", len(set(coloring.values())))

known_edges = [(0,10), (0,11), (0,7), (3,10), (2,9), (1,9), (3,6)]
for u, v in known_edges:
    if not G.has_edge(u, v):
        print(f"Missing edge: {u}, {v}")
